Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidPhysicalProjection

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidPhysicalProjection
public final class PidPhysicalProjection extends Object
Resolves P&ID proposal attachments against the actual source process without inventing auxiliary paths.

Both native drawings and DEXPI projection consume this register. A resolved proposal is a design attachment, not an executable device or an engineering approval.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
